policies.summary: Retain 3-cycle coverage: best forecasted Book/revenue/rank with positive margin and stockouts; buyer routing is justified, but quality and forum promotion remain unproven.
Act on stockouts and price-failure routing; retain 3-cycle coverage and current Buyer/forum settings. Forecasts favor depth, but supply execution and cash guards warrant caution.
Favor measured stockout recovery: 3-cycle coverage has the strongest forecast; retain buyer and forum settings given immature comparisons.

shop.note: Shared-data forecasts, not measured lift. Cash converts to inventory; acquisition alone adds no Book. Stars effect unmodeled; retain validated quality and full refund guards. Select repeat-demand depth by marginal Book/rank, cash and supply delay; raw peer quantities are not targets.

buyer.note: Paid Saved contributions are normalized, not absolute surplus. Pending quality is not success. Post scores are sampled from newest 100 public posts, not causal format lift or the full forum aggregate.

supply_execution_60min.note: POST success counts actual acquisition; prepared plans do not. Legacy refusal events mix quantity, eligibility and reservations.

evaluation.note: Saved uplift over assignment baseline; inverse assignment propensity weighting; completed 6h+10m cohorts, minimum effective samples and latency guard.

prepared_plan.note: Preview is not a supply authorization; fresh guards remain authoritative.

limitations: Short, partial post-deployment period; no randomized causal v18 lift or first-place proof.
Official baseline is a cached board captured 13 seconds before runtime start; endpoint accounting can lag local callbacks.
Journal arrival time and paid_at are reported separately; late-arriving older events are not automatically v18 sales.
Equal-duration previous window has different supply phase, downtime and category mix.
Current inventory and KV observation timestamps differ from the frozen board cutoff.
Gross margin precedes storage and future refunds; observed window refunds may concern older cohorts.
New goods require at least six-hour outcome follow-up; forum format scores are sparse, sampled and age-dependent.
